构成十字形图案；交叉往来
words.ex_en: They criss-crossed the country by bus.
words.ex_zh: 他们乘坐公共汽车在乡间交叉往返。

words.ex_en: They cover him quickly as the crowbar clangs to the ground.
words.ex_zh: 他们迅速掩盖了洞口，撬棍当啷一声，落在了地上。

words.ex_en: The adult characters seemed too crudely drawn; the hopes and dreams of the fathers – and one assumes, the mothers – too easily dismissed.
words.ex_zh: 成年人的角色塑造的太过粗糙，父亲们抑或是母亲们的希望和梦想太过轻易地被排斥。

words.ex_en: The only sound was the crunch of tyres on gravel.
words.ex_zh: 唯一的声音是轮胎压在砂砾上的嘎吱声。

words.ex_en: As geologic forces pulled the crustal plate apart, new volcanoes formed in parts of the rift.
words.ex_zh: 当地质作用力（试图）把地壳版块分开，版块开裂的一些地方就会形成新的火山。

words.ex_en: Teaching materials need to be culturally appropriate.
words.ex_zh: 教材从文化角度来看必须恰当。

words.ex_en: She wrote hymns to the gods in cuneiform.
words.ex_zh: 她用楔形文字写下了献给神祇的颂歌。

words.ex_en: Red and blue spectacles, it was imagined, would be routinely employed to watch a film. Flat projection would be a historical curio.
words.ex_zh: 当时人们认为那种红蓝3D眼镜将是未来观影必备物品，平板投射技术将成为历史古董。

words.ex_en: After the second of third offence I was warned that I should be beaten next time, but I received the warning in a curiously roundabout way.
words.ex_zh: 这样子一两次之后，我被警告，如果再有第三次我会挨揍的。 我以一种好奇的迂回曲则的方式接受了这个警告。

words.ex_en: We were taught how to curtsy to the Queen.
words.ex_zh: 有人教我们如何向女王行屈膝礼。

words.ex_en: Matter, energy and dark energy all produce curvature in space-time, however.
words.ex_zh: 而事实上，物质、能量和暗能量在时空中都会产生弯曲。
